dogecoin.text:
– Join online chaos  
– Buy DOGE for no reason other than “it’s Doge Day, bro”  
– And honor the fact that absurdity *can* move markets

**If Dogecoin were a movie — it’d be "Harold & Kumar Go to the Dogechain"**  
No plot. No logic. Pure vibes.

Dogecoin started as a joke. It stayed a joke. And somehow became **a top-tier crypto celebrity**. It never wanted to change the world. It just raised an eyebrow and whispered: *"much wow."*

**How do we celebrate Doge Day?**  
– Share memes with Kabosu (the OG meme-dog)
